source_location: Fig. 8a (gravimetric) and Fig. 8b (volumetric), Hot-15tDACA curve, p. 12806, read at 40 bar
notes: Curve digitized in curve mode: the plotted markers overlap into one continuous band and cannot be separated, so isotherm_point_count is empty; value read by linear interpolation of the trace at 0.4 x p_end (p_end = 100 bar, the pressure of the last marker). Bulk density of pellets given only as a 0.5-0.55 g/cm3 range for all pellets (not stored). Measured with a volumetric Sieverts-type analyzer; BELSORP-HP named only in SI p. S4 (no manufacturer, so instrument_identified = false). Degassing: main text 120 °C for 12 h (stored); SI p. S4 states 10 h at the activation temperature and SI p. basis_evidence: SI p. S4: "The measured excess adsorption capacities were subsequently converted to total gravimetric and volumetric adsorption values using eqs. S1–S2." with eq. S1: Gtot(P,T)grav = Gex(P,T) + rho_gas(P,T) Va
